snippet.title: Above: Colonies of the Mist | Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam! 

Build temporary hilltop colonies in a world consumed by deadly mist. Manage scarce resources, explore ancient ruins hidden in the fog, and search for technologies that might help you escape before everything is lost.
